reason: The original protocol fixed ATR multiples but omitted the ATR formula and lookback. This amendment fixes those details before any executable economic outcome is calculated.

atr.formula: simple arithmetic mean of the latest 14 true ranges; true range is max(high-low, abs(high-previous_close), abs(low-previous_close)) and therefore requires 15 contiguous completed M15 candles
atr.availability: every source candle must have completed and been ingested no later than decision_at_utc
atr.source: one canonical source across the 15-candle window; source transition, gap, invalid OHLC or missing availability is UNVERIFIABLE
atr.rounding: no intermediate rounding; broker price precision only applies at a future order boundary

cost_clarification.commission: zero explicit commission only for broker-classified non-share spread-priced FX, index and commodity CFDs supported by official IG South Africa product terms
cost_clarification.financing: exclude an opportunity from every policy family if its conservative maximum holding window intersects 22:00 Europe/London; do not estimate a variable overnight rate
cost_clarification.slippage: retain the original development-only per-market 75th and 95th percentile spread sensitivity assumptions
